name: project
text: A liveness stamp a test fakes with a process must not be a child the test leaves unreaped: an ended child is a zombie that osx.alive() in another process still reports alive, so a controller waiting on it never sees it end. Start such a process detached (`sh -c 'sleep N >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo $!'`). (inferred from core/osx.alive)
